from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    one = next((r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if out[r][c] == 1)
    two = next((r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if out[r][c] == 2)
    r, c = one
    tr, tc = two
    sr = 1 if tr > r else -1
    sc = 1 if tc > c else -1
    diagonal_steps = max(0, min(abs(tr-r), abs(tc-c)) - 1)
    for _ in range(diagonal_steps):
        r += sr
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tr-r) > 1 or abs(tc-c) > 1:
        if abs(tr-r) > 1:
            r += sr
        else:
            c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-cafade91.py'
path.write_text(source)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_cafade91', path)
